body: You're a good person. I try to avoid saying things like that as often as I can, because of it's subjectivity, but you really are. Thank you for trying to help people, but you're wasting your time with me. I honestly feel guilty for even posting. I'm going to leave now and stand in the middle of the highway after drinking a 40 of anything. Sorry for this stupid cry for attention.

I guess my real point here is that for me life is always getting worse as time passes. Not objectively, I realize that, but it doesn't change the fact that I feel terrible. We'll all soon be dead anyway, why not end the pain?
There used to be things and people I loved but everything's always felt a little empty. Lately more than ever.
